params.name: pantry
params.rationale: What the old alcove becomes when the refrigerator leaves it. No wall is removed for any of them: 'open' (the recess lined with shelves on its back and both sides, no door), 'door' (the same behind a hinged door) or 'cabinets' (tall cabinets with fronts in the lower colour).

params.name: microwave_at
params.rationale: 'counter' (as today), 'pantry' (a shelf at 30 in in the alcove) or 'island' (a drawer microwave in the island).

params.name: stow_pins
params.rationale: Things the owner wants in one particular place whatever the rules in `stow()` say, as 'thing=place; thing=place' with ids from model/inventory.py and from `bays()`. Empty: every thing goes where the rules put it. A pinned thing still has to fit, and the claims about where things are still judge it.

params.name: knife_strip
params.rationale: Where the magnetic knife strip hangs. Today it is on the backsplash beside the microwave, in the corner. 'backsplash' puts it on the long wall just south of the range, over the counter the cook preps on, on the range-to-refrigerator leg of the triangle; 'fridge_panel' on the side of the new refrigerator housing, facing that same counter; 'none' leaves the knives in a drawer.

params.name: managed_by
params.rationale: 'self': the person hires the trades; 'gc': a general contractor adds 18%.

params.name: budget_usd
params.rationale: USD, the whole job: kitchen and upstairs floors. The person's number.

params.name: sales_tax
params.rationale: Edmonds combined rate (location code 3104), 6.5% state + 4.2% local, in effect from 1 April 2026 per the WA DOR table as quoted by two aggregators; the Q4 2026 notice was not seen. Washington taxes remodel labour as well as materials, so it applies to every line but permits.

params.name: contingency
params.rationale: Of the pre-tax subtotal. 10% is a contractor's usual line and 20% a budgeting guide's; 12 because the sink and the range stay where they are, and the island drain and the refrigerator circuit are the only work inside walls.

asserted.hint: accepted provisionally, with a reason and an owner — an assumption, or a claim carried outside an evaluator's operating context — unresolved

blocked.hint: an evaluator skipped — its tool is missing here, it skipped itself on its input, or a prerequisite is not established — and none failed: no usable verdict

errored.hint: an evaluator errored: it crashed, so nothing was evaluated, and the evaluator itself is broken

fail.hint: an evaluator failed the current design, a physical result failed, or an evaluator's value does not meet the claim's acceptance condition

pass.hint: every evaluator is qualified and passed on the current inputs, inside its operating context, and every value compared with the acceptance condition meets it — checked does not mean true

pending.hint: an evaluator of the claim is unrun on the current inputs

refuted.hint: an evaluator failed the current design, a physical result failed, or an evaluator's value does not meet the claim's acceptance condition

stale.hint: a pass whose read set has changed since, or whose prerequisite is invalidated or unrun: nothing is checked now

unclaimed.hint: no evaluator, none qualified, one unqualified, or one outside its operating context; or an assumption nobody owns

unverified.hint: waits on an article: no physical result yet, or a pass no article binds to the current inputs

verified.hint: every evaluator is qualified and passed on the current inputs, inside its operating context, and every value compared with the acceptance condition meets it — checked does not mean true
